{{Top|leg}}
The '''Promised Land journals''' were the findings of certain [[Outcasts (Taris)|Outcasts]] in the [[Undercity (Taris)|Undercity]] of the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|Ecumenopolis]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] who searching for the [[Promised Land]], a near-mythical paradise, located on Taris. Each one contained various recorded clues of the location of the fabled paradise.<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>

In [[3956 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the events of ''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic'' at 3956 BBY.</ref> the Outcast named, [[Rukil]] was searching for the journal of his apprentice [[Malya]], [[Rukil's father|his father's]] journal, and the journal of [[Rukil's grandfather|his grandfather]]. Rukil obtained the aid of the amnesiac former [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] in order to find the journals and locate the Promised Land.<ref name="KOTOR" />
